clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952, within the year: June grew homesick and wrote to her sister daily, then kept to her bed for weeks that winter; Walter was out in the trees from dark to dark and rows broke out between them over money for new trees; Glen had fights at his new school; Walter stopped writing to his brother Harlan after a quarrel over their father's land money. By September 1953, June joined the church choir and her letters thinned out, her anxiety eased and her functioning rose, where things settled.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968, within the year: Walter drank heavily most nights; he and Glen blamed each other and rows broke out; Glen took over the family's money and talks with the bank; Carl's asthma attacks worsened that winter; Nora began wetting the bed in April 1969; Ida was found to have heart trouble and told to stop working. By October 1969, Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning other men's trees, his functioning rose, where things settled.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the year: Glen sat out in the truck for hours most of that year; loud fights broke out with Marian at night over money; Marian took a second job cleaning offices at night; Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer; Nora kept to her room and distanced from her mother; Walter drank again after six years off it. By June 1976, Nora was eating again and made the track team, her functioning rose, where things settled.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Sam's house in January 1990, within the year: Nora clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals; Sam worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows; Sam took his mother's side; Owen had tantrums at preschool; Wilma took over Lily's care; Nora's eczema flared on both hands; rows broke out most nights between Nora and Sam. By June 1991, when Wilma took a flat in town, Nora's eczema cleared over the summer, where things settled.
